context: Charity Gala. Jessica approaches for interview.

nodes.text: Senator John! Jessica Chen, Channel 7 News. Got a minute for a quick comment on tonight's gala?

moodVariations.Stressed: Senator! Jessica Chen, Channel 7. Quick comment?
moodVariations.Relaxed: Senator John! Jessica Chen, Channel 7 News!
moodVariations.Neutral: Senator John! Jessica Chen, Channel 7 News. Quick comment?

publicOptions.text: Of course, Jessica. What do you need?
Not now. I'm working the room.

privateThoughts.text: Sharp journalist. Could be ally or adversary depending on treatment.

nodes.text: Great. So—this gala is about women's leadership, but your voting record on the Family Act says otherwise. How do you reconcile that?

moodVariations.Stressed: Gala's about women's leadership, but your Family Act vote says otherwise. Reconcile?
moodVariations.Relaxed: So—women's leadership gala, but your Family Act vote? How do you reconcile?
moodVariations.Neutral: This gala is about women's leadership. Your Family Act vote seems contradictory.

publicOptions.text: My education funding disproportionately helps women. That's what matters.
The Family Act had flaws. I voted my principles, not pressure.
Fair question. I acknowledge the concern, but stand by my record.

nodes.text: Of course, Senator. I'll note you were unavailable for comment.

moodVariations.Relaxed: Of course! I'll note you were busy.
moodVariations.Neutral: I'll note you were unavailable for comment.

delayed.effect: Jessica less sympathetic during scandal, risk +10

nodes.text: Interesting. One more—your opponent claims you're out of touch on women's issues. Your response?

moodVariations.Stressed: Opponent says you're out of touch on women's issues. Response?
moodVariations.Relaxed: One more—opponent says you're out of touch. Response?
moodVariations.Neutral: Your opponent claims you're out of touch on women's issues.

publicOptions.text: My record speaks for itself. Education, healthcare access, pay equity—I've delivered.
I respect my opponent, but disagree. Let the voters decide.
That's a cheap shot. She knows it. I know it.

nodes.text: Perfect. That's all I need. Thanks for your time, Senator.

moodVariations.Neutral: Perfect. That's all I need. Thanks.
